name: Marcille
title: Petra Construction
description: The site foreman of Petra Construction. She works hard every day in the hopes of eventually buying a carrot farm to run with her family.
introduction:
A site foreman of the Petra Construction. The eldest of eight siblings born in a remote mountain village on the outskirts of Kalaid.

Marcille may look like a sharp-eyed tough kid, but in reality she is an outstanding field worker who has even been selected as Employee of the Month. Her dream is to own a large farm, and she works overtime every day and takes on side jobs to someday buy a carrot farm to run with her family.

After being reassigned to the Petra Construction team as part of a pilot operation, she has been burdened with scheduling, accounting, site supervision, and even looking after the immature Petra and Tanya in their stead, giving her no end of headaches.
